sentences.text: Dr. James Evan Wilson , M.D. , is a fictional character on the Fox medical drama House .	House	House (TV series)	fictional character	fictional character	Fox	Fox Broadcasting Company	medical drama	medical drama
He is played by Robert Sean Leonard .	Robert Sean Leonard	Robert Sean Leonard
The character first appears in the show 's pilot episode when he introduces a medical case to Dr. Gregory House .	House	House (TV series)	Gregory House	Gregory House
Wilson is Dr. House 's only true friend , and frequently provides him with consultations and aid .	House	House (TV series)

Wilson is the head of the Department of Oncology at Princeton-Plainsboro Teaching Hospital .	Oncology	Oncology	Princeton	Princeton University	Plainsboro	Plainsboro Township, New Jersey	Teaching Hospital	Teaching Hospital
During the show 's run , the characters of House and Wilson have been compared to Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson .	House	House (TV series)	Sherlock Holmes	Sherlock Holmes	Dr Watson	Dr Watson

Wilson 's portrayer , Robert Sean Leonard , has stated that his character and Dr. House were originally supposed to play these roles ; but Dr. House 's diagnostic team has taken over Dr. Watson 's part .	House	House (TV series)	Robert Sean Leonard	Robert Sean Leonard
Leonard also read the script of the pilot episode of CBS ' Numb3rs and was planning to audition .	CBS	CBS	Numb3rs	Numb3rs

He auditioned for House instead because he felt he would more enjoy playing the character that House went to for help and because he liked The Odd Couple dynamic of the relationship .	House	House (TV series)	The Odd Couple	The Odd Couple

Alan Sepinwall of The Star-Ledger described Wilson as `` the only irreplaceable supporting character '' of the show , as well as Maureen Ryan of the Chicago Tribune , who stated that Wilson can `` never , never , never , never '' leave the show .	The Star-Ledger	The Star-Ledger	Chicago Tribune	Chicago Tribune

The character 's name is derived from two neighboring buildings -LRB- James Administration Building and Wilson Hall -RRB- at McGill University 's downtown campus , in Montreal , Quebec .	McGill University	McGill University	Montreal	Montreal	Quebec	Quebec
